inputs.text: [excited] Its open wings spanned 6 meters wingtip to wingtip — wide as a car and a half! Laid end to end, that's [quickly] as long as a road is wide — it takes up the whole street! Standing up, it was 1.8 meters tall — [proud] as tall as Dad standing up! And it weighed 25 kilos — as heavy as a dog. [amazed] And flying, scientists think it could go 20 miles an hour — as fast as a horse cantering.
[curious] And that funny crest, [gasps] behind its head?
[confident] It may have helped steer its flight, [slowly] like a rudder.
